summary: Configured node1 to require passwords of at least 12 characters and at least three character classes. The policy persisted through a verified node reboot; the OS release and kernel remained unchanged.
actions_performed: Verified PAM consumes pam_pwquality for system-auth and password-auth.
Confirmed rejection of an 11-character/four-class password and a 12-character/two-class password, while accepting a 12-character/four-class password.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified complete recovery and policy persistence.

evidence.requirement: Require at least 12 characters and three character classes
evidence.summary: Shows the persistent policy file and direct pre- and post-reboot enforcement tests for both boundaries.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 were unchanged.
